about: 17 text probes selected from the new guide, one per drawing or step convention that the 40 correct answers depend on. A probe matches a document set when one of its patterns matches the prose (Markdown) of that set, after lowercasing, removing backticks and asterisks and collapsing whitespace. The probes follow the new guide's wording, so the current prose matches 17 of 17 by construction. A probe that does not match the baseline prose does not prove that the baseline lacks the convention: it may be stated in other words, or shown only by an example. The notes give related baseline text found by hand, without a claim of completeness. Reproduce with: python3 evals/dev-authoring/tools/inventory.py. Inventory and probes were checked in during the fix round after b02d9bd; the baseline notes below were re-read from the files at 5e4952e.

conventions.convention: A vector angle is degrees counter-clockwise from +x (0 right, 90 up).
probes: degrees counter-?clockwise from \+x
conventions.baselineNotes: No probe match. Related text: PROTOCOL.md:110 gives the world axes (right/up, origin bottom-left) but not the angle sense or zero direction.

conventions.convention: A vector anchored with on starts at the item's edge, not its centre.
probes: on an item starts at the item's edge

conventions.convention: An incline's at is its bottom-left (acute) vertex.
probes: incline's at is its bottom-left vertex
\| incline \| at is the bottom-left
conventions.baselineNotes: No probe match. Related text: PROTOCOL.md:113 lists incline as a kind only.

conventions.convention: The incline's slope rises to the right.
probes: slope (always )?rises to the right

conventions.convention: A plot's at is the lower-left corner of its w x h frame.
probes: plot, axes and bars anchor at their lower-left corner
\| plot \| at is the lower-left corner
conventions.baselineNotes: No probe match. Related text: PROTOCOL.md:30 says axes start at their lower-left, but in the layer2d video paragraph (canvas pixels).

conventions.convention: Plot pts are data coordinates, mapped through xr and yr.
probes: pts are data coordinates

conventions.convention: A bars item's at is the lower-left corner of its frame.
probes: plot, axes and bars anchor at their lower-left corner
\| bars \| at is the lower-left corner

conventions.convention: Bar heights are scaled to the largest |value|.
probes: heights are scaled to the largest

conventions.convention: An array's at is the centre of the row.
probes: \| array \| at is the centre
array and table at their centre

conventions.convention: A table's at is its centre.
probes: table: required at \(centre\)
\| table \| at is the centre
array and table at their centre

conventions.convention: Table marked pairs count rows from the first row; the header is row 0.
probes: counted from the first row
conventions.baselineNotes: No probe match. Related text: PROTOCOL.md:184 gives marked as [row, column] integer pairs without the origin.

conventions.convention: An edge's Boolean dir: true draws an arrow from a to b.
probes: dir: true draws an arrow from a to b

conventions.convention: A ground line hatches the right-hand side of its direction of travel.
probes: ground hatches the right-hand side

conventions.convention: The first frame already applies step 0's edits.
probes: first frame is step 0 with step 0's edits already applied
first frame already applies step 0's edits

conventions.convention: An item first listed in a show is hidden before that step and visible from it on.
probes: item first listed at step k is hidden before step k
item first listed in a show appears at that step
conventions.baselineNotes: No probe match. Related text: PROTOCOL.md:484 gives the limit of 16 shown ids per step only.

conventions.convention: A step edit's value replaces the whole field (send the full list).
probes: the value replaces the whole field
conventions.baselineNotes: No probe match. Related text: PROTOCOL.md:335 says a sent list replaces the whole list for the params patch operation.

conventions.convention: Numbers in cells and bars show no decimals from 100, one from 10, two below 10.
probes: no decimals from 100, one decimal from 10, two below 10
conventions.baselineNotes: No probe match. Related text: PROTOCOL.md:31 gives a 4-significant-digit formatter for layer2d video ticks.
